load_imagenet_split: load an ImageNet dataset split with preprocessing, sharding, and batching for JAX training
normalize_images_imagenet: normalize image tensors using ImageNet mean and standard deviation statistics with JAX
transpose_images_tpu: transpose image batches from NHWC to NCHW format for TPU training performance
split_from_string: convert a string like TRAIN or VALID into a Split enum for dataset loading
split_num_examples: get the number of examples for a given ImageNet dataset split like TRAIN or TEST
